dataList.title: Head to 3F
dataList.description:
2F is currently "undergoing renovations." Now matter how you cut it, it didn't look like your average construction project. 

Since we can't explore the floor anyway, perhaps we should get on the escalator and check out 3F first.

dataList.title: Follow the Snip-snip
dataList.description: We're on 3F. What sounds like a distant pair of scissors are going snip-snip. Let's see where that sound's coming from.

steps.goalDescription1: Follow the snip-snip and explore the area to the top

dataList.title: Head to the Corridor
dataList.description:
We met Annette the Alterationist. I suppose she'll come in handy if we ever need a bundle of fabric woven.
For now, time to leave.

steps.goalDescription1: Leave the Alteration Shop and head back to the corridor

dataList.title: Explore 3F
dataList.description:
Sadly, we weren't able to get through to Two-piece. Or is it Two-pieces?

Anyways, let's explore the remaining areas first. That store to the left, for example.

steps.goalDescription1: Head to the store on the left

dataList.title: Talk to the Rouge at the Boutique
dataList.description:
We found ourselves inside a store called the "Boutique." A disembodied voice, probably belonging to a "Giant," constantly recites a mantra throughout the store.
Let's talk to the vendor and see if there's anything more we could learn about this place.

steps.goalDescription1: Talk to the employee at Boutique du Rouge

dataList.title: Head to the PA Room
dataList.description:
The Rouge employee, L'Inamovible, looks distraught that the "Voice" would only repeat what it has said before and wants to know why.
But the Voice's identity is Meursault's mother, who'd already passed away... Still, we decided to head to the PA Room as asked.

dataList.title: Return to L'Inamovible
dataList.description:
Received an PA Room Audiotape from the 3F Floor Manager. Maybe this tape contains the Giant's voice?

Time to return to Boutique du Rouge and hand this over to L'Inamovible.

dataList.title: Return to L'Inamovible
dataList.description:
Received an PA Room Audiotape from the 3F Floor Manager. Maybe this tape contains the Giant's voice?

Time to return to Boutique du Rouge and hand this over to L'Inamovible.

dataList.title: Talk to Two-piece (2)
dataList.description:
Okay, their "meeting" should be over by now. I hope.
Let's return to Two-piece blocking the corridor to the right and find out.

steps.goalDescription1: Talk to Two-piece in the corridor

dataList.title: Head to the Alteration Shop
dataList.description:
The meeting is still underway with no signs of ever adjourning.
Outis and Sinclair exchanged a look, then suggested that we head to the Alteration Shop... Maybe they've come up with a plan?

dataList.title: Head to the Right
dataList.description:
Like Annette said, the scissors were well-sharpened, and managed to snip-snip the Two-piece into two-pieces.
Let's explore what's behind them.

steps.goalDescription1: Head to the store on the right

dataList.title: Eliminate Enthralled Noirs
dataList.description:
Made it to Maison du Noir.
Flannel and Felt, two Noirs managing the store, want to "premiumize" their brand and asked us to remove a few Noirs who were enthralled by a foreign Voice.
We should talk to them after removing a few enthralled Noirs—about 3 should do.

dataList.title: Purchase a Pair of Scissors and Adjourn the Meeting
dataList.description:
Annette the Alterationist was selling a few pairs of scissors, last I recall.
Let's purchase a pair of "Well-sharpened Sewing Scissors" and head back to Two-piece.
Outis and Sinclair are both wearing the same strange, self-satisfied grin on their faces.

Wait, are they planning to—?

steps.goalDescription1: Purchase a pair of "Well-sharpened Sewing Scissors" from Annette the Alterationist
Return to Two-piece in the corridor

dataList.title: Bring the Noirs up to Speed
dataList.description:
A note we found in the Happy Closet's remains said something about "Golden Fabric" and "Nail." Maybe this is the recipe to crafting that legendary weapon that One-leg mentioned?
Let's bring this back to that One-leg in the 4F Noir Footwear Hall as promised, then return to Flannel and Felt at Maison du Noir on 3F.

steps.goalDescription1: Talk to the Arc Floor Lamp before leaving
Talk to the One-leg in the 4F Noir Footwear Hall
Talk to Flannel in the 3F Maison du Noir

dataList.title: Head to the Alteration Shop
dataList.description: We're back on 3F. Let's bring the Golden Skein back to Annette the Alterationist, and she'll weave a Golden Fabric out of it.

dataList.title: Head to Boutique du Rouge
dataList.description:
Received the Golden Fabric from Annette the Alterationist... Now, to obtain the Nail.
We should be able to get the "Nail"—or, as the Noirs said, "L'Inamovible's spine"—from Boutique du Rouge.

dataList.title: Obtain the "Nail" and Return to Maison du Noir
dataList.description:
L'Inamovible's Distortion quickly exacerbated before our eyes, so we had to cut her down.
Time to remove her spi—"Nail."
Now, we only need to drape the Golden Fabric around the nail to complete the legendary weapon of the Noirs, capable of ripping through any and all fabric.

Time to return to Maison du Noir and deliver the news to Flannel and Felt.
